_note: Arrow wounds on skeletal dragons: arrows rattle between bones, chip and wedge in them. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the arrowhead clacking off bone. Bone chips fly and {name} jerks, jaws snapping.
, the point wedging into bone that is already cracked. The crack widens with a loud snap and {name} lets out a hollow, rasping roar.
, and the arrow smashes the cracked bone apart. Splinters scatter and the binding glow flares; {name} thrashes, frame rattling.
, and it is too much. {name} crashes down in a clattering heap of bone and arrows, the glow in the sockets dimming.
